name: leaflets
description: Build brand-matched applicant leaflets (explainer pages) for any online or government service, with an optional named voice guide that narrates the page. The brand is matched to a target site you point at (URL or screenshots); the guide's name, man/woman voice, and language are user-chosen. Includes service-concept-brief: derive a traced, conceptual 'what each type IS' content map per branch by cross-reading the law and the live BPA service.
